title: Flint Dagger
description: A mod that seeks to change a bit the early game, investing in flint as a material and a few tweaks (recipes, entity spawning to greaten difficulty). Exclusively tested for Fabric 1.20.1.
body:
Flint Dagger is a mod for Fabric 1.20.1 that adds 9 new items to the game, alongside changing spawning mechanics for Cave Spiders & Wither Skeletons & the Silverfish, some loots in structures & the loot of Bats (for Bat Wings to craft the unique Bat Glider) and that of the Silverfish (very rarely dropping an Iron Nugget).

![The mod in the Creative menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4a11f138298b717e25f9bc567acfe957bdcf151.png)
The Gravel block now drops from an enriched looting table, making grinding for materials fun while redefining it as a compound of various sediments.

![Loot table of gravel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/069b959d0aed97ee2e9507cb4f09ff72f4550398.png)

You can now craft an early game Flint Dagger that has the best possible attack speed, bringing back 1.8 PVP, and that can be updated to a Diamond Dagger later on. The Flint Shovel and Axe have the strength of equivalent stone tools. The Flint Dagger Guide informs you even more ingame.

![Custom items' recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a923c0084dd7b184e32d9b0a68123e0956229e1.png)

The Flintlock Pistol uses Gunpowder & Iron Nuggets to fire Fire Charges, which you can use to set things on fire from far away or damage mobs.
